Note to self Ifmyante wrote: Bushido wrote: Hello!

My opinion after checking your chart below: - the right H isn't in the same or lower line of price like the left one (starting of QM) - also the wicks are not so long - should be more obvious that there is rejection of the price at that level The teachers will tell - but I wouldn't consider this as valid QM.

We can get into trouble looking for a "to the pip" entry on a QM. In a QM at S, sure we look for the break above the initial H, which is where the buyers get trapped, but it's the DP to break back down after the HH that we look for in a QM, which need not be exactly at the level of the left shoulder

author: dengaima
text:
3rd last arrow from the right is demand and the second from the right is ignored demand. See how if marked the box? He marked between decisions and high = PAZ.

Also where you marked other arrows on the left looks like CP.

Ignored levels are always respected sooner or later. Reason = Demand becomes Supply and vice versa. Also they are fresh levels once they break something significant.

In this case I think it broke flag limit.

I noticed how you mark the levels thinking they are fresh in your journey.. I suggest u to check HTF to see if they are really fresh levels.

Dengaima
